title: 第十三章 校园角落的能量波动第十四章 第一次实战考核
lines: 第十三章：校园角落的能量波动
暮色像一层被稀释的墨，正沿着斯卡市的天际线缓缓晕开。幻境学院的钟楼敲过七下，最后一缕金红的霞光掠过图书馆尖顶的琉璃瓦，落在西侧那片几乎被人遗忘的废弃植物园里。
林澈蹲在一丛枯萎的“月光草”前，指尖悬在草叶上方半寸处。细微的空间涟漪在他指缝间流转，像一群不安分的银色小鱼——这是他觉醒“空间感知”天赋后，第一次如此清晰地捕捉到非人为的能量异动。
“还是找不到源头吗？”苏璃的声音从身后传来，带着植物特有的清润气息。她刚结束草药课的补习，怀里还抱着一本摊开的《灵植图鉴》，书页上标注着月光草的特性：“喜静，畏强光，若周边有魔法能量紊乱，叶片会呈现灰黑色卷曲状。”
林澈抬起头，视线扫过植物园深处。这里是学院建校时就存在的区域，后来因为一场不明原因的火灾，大部分灵植枯萎，便逐渐被废弃，只剩下几座倾颓的玻璃暖房，和缠绕在锈迹斑斑的铁架上的枯藤。此刻，他指尖的空间感知正传来一阵阵微弱的震颤，像是有什么东西在地下深处“呼吸”，每一次起伏，都带着紊乱的魔法能量。
“从昨天开始就这样了。”林澈皱着眉，“上午上飞行课的时候，我在操场边缘就感觉到了，能量源头好像就在这附近。刚才来确认，发现这片月光草全枯了，而且……”他顿了顿，指向暖房角落的一块地面，“那里的空间波动最明显，像是有个能量场在不断扩张、收缩。”
苏璃顺着他指的方向走去，蹲下身，伸出手指轻轻触碰地面。土壤是干燥的，带着火烧后的焦糊味，但指尖传来的并非冰凉，而是一种极其微弱的灼热感，像是有细小的火星在地下燃烧。她闭上眼，调动起灵都国特有的“生命共鸣”能力——这是一种能与植物、土壤甚至岩石沟通的魔法，虽然她还只是初学，但足够捕捉到环境中细微的生命迹象。
片刻后，她猛地睁开眼，眼底掠过一丝惊惶：“不对，这下面有‘活物’的气息，但不是植物，也不是动物……像是一种纯粹的能量体，而且它的波动很不稳定，像是在挣扎。”
“能量体？”林澈站起身，走到她身边，“学院里除了师生的魔法能量，还有什么能量体能藏在这种地方？”
就在这时，一阵急促的脚步声从植物园入口传来，伴随着金属碰撞的哐当声。凯提着一个装着火焰符咒的皮袋，快步走了进来，额头上还带着汗：“你们果然在这！刚才在宿舍没找到你们，听低年级的学生说看到你们往这边来了。”他的目光扫过枯萎的月光草，眉头立刻皱了起来，“怎么回事？这里的能量不对劲，我的符咒刚才一直在发烫。”
凯来自魔法国的火纹家族，对能量波动的敏感度不亚于林澈，尤其是与火焰相关的能量。他从皮袋里掏出一张黄色符咒，符咒上用朱砂绘制的火焰图案此刻正泛着不正常的红光，边缘甚至有轻微的焦痕。
“我们也在查。”林澈简明扼要地把情况说了一遍，“地下有个能量体在活动，导致周边魔法能量紊乱。”
凯走到那块波动最明显的地面旁，蹲下身，将手掌平放在地上。他没有像苏璃那样尝试沟通，而是直接调动起体内的火焰魔法，让一丝微弱的火苗在掌心跳动。当火苗接触到地面的瞬间，他猛地缩回手，低呼一声：“好强的排斥力！这能量体好像很怕火，我刚靠近，它就发出了反击的波动。”
“怕火？”苏璃若有所思，“那会不会是水属性的能量体？但水属性能量紊乱的话，土壤应该是湿润的才对……”
“不一定。”一个清冷的声音突然从暖房的阴影里传来。
三人同时转头，只见月姬不知何时站在那里，一身银灰色的校服裙摆被晚风吹得轻轻晃动。她手里拿着一面小巧的青铜镜，镜面正对着地面，反射出一道微弱的白光。镜幻国的人擅长通过镜像观察事物的本质，尤其是那些肉眼难以捕捉的能量轨迹。
“你们看。”月姬举起铜镜，将镜面转向三人。镜中并没有映照出他们的身影，而是浮现出一片扭曲的光影——在植物园地下约三米深的地方，有一团模糊的黑色雾状体，正不断地收缩、膨胀，每一次变化，都有细小的黑色丝线从雾状体中溢出，渗透到土壤里，而那些丝线所过之处，月光草的根系都呈现出焦黑的状态。
“这不是自然形成的能量体。”月姬的声音很轻，却带着不容置疑的笃定，“它的核心是黑色的，而且在不断吞噬周围的魔法能量，包括土壤里残留的生命能量。你们看它的边缘，有规则的纹路，像是被人用魔法强行束缚过。”
林澈凑近铜镜，果然在黑色雾状体的边缘看到了一圈淡金色的光晕，那光晕断断续续，像是一道即将破碎的屏障。“这是……封印？”他忽然想起入学时导师讲过的基础魔法理论，“有一种古老的‘囚笼咒’，能将能量体封锁在特定空间，边缘会留下施咒者的魔法印记。如果封印松动，被囚禁的能量体就会试图突破，导致周边能量紊乱。”
“那这东西到底是什么？”凯握紧了拳头，掌心的火苗又跳动起来，“如果它突破封印，会不会有危险？”
月姬没有立刻回答，而是调整了铜镜的角度，镜面的光影随之变化，隐约能看到黑色雾状体中，包裹着一点微弱的蓝色光芒。“镜中显示，它的核心是‘元素之核’，但被一层暗影能量包裹着。”她顿了顿，眼神变得复杂，“而且这暗影能量……和我之前在古籍库看到的星图残片上的气息很像。”
“星图残片？”林澈心头一震，“就是那幅据说记载着秘境坐标的星图？”
苏璃突然“啊”了一声，像是想起了什么，她快速翻开怀里的《灵植图鉴》，翻到其中一页，指着上面的插图：“你们看这个！这是‘暗影藤’的根系图，据说这种植物只在有强烈暗影能量的地方生长，它的根系会吸收周围的光明能量，留下类似烧焦的痕迹……和这片月光草的枯萎状态一模一样！”
插图上的根系纹路，竟与铜镜中黑色雾状体边缘的淡金色印记有几分相似。
凯的脸色沉了下来：“暗影能量、囚笼咒、星图残片……这会不会和那些关于‘暗影教派’的传闻有关？我听说他们一直在找能增强暗影魔法的东西。”
“不管和谁有关，现在的问题是，这个能量体的封印快撑不住了。”林澈的指尖再次泛起银色涟漪，他能清晰地感觉到，地下的空间波动越来越剧烈，那层淡金色的封印正在一点点碎裂，“如果它完全突破，这里的能量爆炸可能会波及整个西校区，甚至影响到学院的结界。”
content_en:
Chapter 13: Energy fluctuations in campus corners
The twilight is like a layer of diluted ink, slowly spreading along the skyline of Ska City. The bell tower of Illusion Academy struck seven times, and the last ray of golden-red light passed over the glazed tiles on the top of the library and fell on the almost forgotten abandoned botanical garden on the west side.
Lin Che squatted in front of a withered "Moonlight Grass", her fingertips hanging half an inch above the grass blades. Subtle spatial ripples flowed between his fingers, like a group of restless silver fish - this was the first time he had so clearly captured non-artificial energy changes after awakening his "space perception" talent.
"Still can't find the source?" Su Li's voice came from behind, carrying the unique freshness of plants. She had just finished tutoring in the herbal medicine class, and she was holding an open "Spiritual Plant Illustrated Book" in her arms. The characteristics of moonlight grass were marked on the pages: "It likes silence and is afraid of strong light. If there is magic energy disorder around it, the leaves will appear gray-black and curled."
Lin Che raised her head and scanned the depths of the botanical garden. This was the area that existed when the college was founded. Later, due to an unknown fire, most of the spiritual plants withered and was gradually abandoned. Only a few crumbling glass greenhouses and dead vines wrapped around the rusty iron frames remained. At this moment, the spatial perception of his fingertips was sending waves of faint tremors, as if something was "breathing" deep underground, with every ups and downs carrying chaotic magical energy.
"It's been like this since yesterday." Lin Che frowned, "During the flying class in the morning, I felt it on the edge of the playground. The energy source seemed to be nearby. I just came to check and found that the moonlight grass was all withered, and..." He paused and pointed to a piece of ground in the corner of the greenhouse, "The spatial fluctuations there are the most obvious, as if there is an energy field that is constantly expanding and contracting."
Su Li walked in the direction he pointed, squatted down, stretched out her fingers and lightly touched the ground. The soil was dry, with a burnt smell from the fire, but what came to my fingertips was not a cold feeling, but an extremely weak burning sensation, as if there were tiny sparks burning underground. She closed her eyes and mobilized Lingdu Kingdom's unique "life resonance" ability - this is a magic that can communicate with plants, soil and even rocks. Although she is only a beginner, it is enough to capture subtle signs of life in the environment.
After a moment, she opened her eyes suddenly, and a trace of panic flashed in her eyes: "No, there is the breath of 'living things' down here, but it is not a plant or an animal... It is like a pure energy body, and its fluctuations are very unstable, as if it is struggling."
"Energy body?" Lin Che stood up and walked to her side, "Aside from the magical energy of teachers and students in the academy, what other energy body can be hidden in a place like this?"
At this moment, a rush of footsteps came from the entrance of the Botanical Garden, accompanied by the clang of metal collisions. Kai walked in quickly with a leather bag containing a flame charm, sweat still on his forehead: "You are indeed here! I didn't find you in the dormitory just now. I heard from the lower-grade students that they saw you coming here." His eyes swept over the withered moonlight grass, and his brows immediately frowned, "What's going on? There's something wrong with the energy here, and my charm has been burning just now."
Kai comes from the Fire Mark family of the Magic Kingdom and is as sensitive to energy fluctuations as Lin Che, especially the energy related to flames. He took out a yellow talisman from his leather bag. The flame pattern drawn with cinnabar on the talisman was glowing abnormally red at the moment, and there were even slight scorch marks on the edges.
"We are also investigating." Lin Che briefly explained the situation, "There is an energy body moving underground, causing chaos in the surrounding magical energy."
Kai walked to the patch of ground with the most obvious fluctuations, squatted down, and placed his palms flat on the ground. He did not try to communicate like Su Li, but directly mobilized the fire magic in his body, letting a faint flame beat in the palm of his hand. When the flames touched the ground, he suddenly retracted his hand and whispered: "What a strong repulsive force! This energy body seems to be afraid of fire. As soon as I got close, it sent out a wave of counterattack."
"Afraid of fire?" Su Li thought thoughtfully, "Could it be a water-attributed energy body? But if the water-attributed energy is disordered, the soil should be moist..."
"Not necessarily." A cold voice suddenly came from the shadow of the greenhouse.
The three of them turned their heads at the same time and saw Yue Ji standing there at some point, her silver-gray school uniform skirt swaying slightly in the evening breeze. She held a small bronze mirror in her hand. The mirror was facing the ground, reflecting a faint white light. People from the Mirror Fantasy Kingdom are good at observing the essence of things through mirror images, especially those energy tracks that are difficult to capture with the naked eye.
"Look." Yue Ji raised the bronze mirror and turned the mirror to the three of them. Their figures were not reflected in the mirror, but a distorted light and shadow emerged - about three meters underground in the botanical garden, there was a fuzzy black mist that was constantly shrinking and expanding. With every change, tiny black threads overflowed from the mist and penetrated into the soil. Wherever those threads passed, the roots of the moongrass were in a charred state.
"This is not a naturally formed energy body." Yue Ji's voice was very soft, but with unquestionable certainty. "Its core is black, and it is constantly devouring the surrounding magical energy, including the remaining life energy in the soil. Look at its edges, there are regular lines, as if it has been forcibly bound by magic."
Lin Che moved closer to the bronze mirror, and sure enough she saw a circle of light golden halo around the edge of the black mist. The halo was intermittent, like a barrier about to be broken. "Is this... a seal?" He suddenly remembered the basic magic theory taught by his tutor when he entered school. "There is an ancient 'cage spell' that can seal the energy body in a specific space, and the magic mark of the caster will be left on the edge. If the seal is loose, the imprisoned energy body will try to break through, causing surrounding energy chaos."
"Then what exactly is this thing?" Kai clenched his fist, and the flames in his palm began to pulse again. "If it breaks through the seal, will it be dangerous?"
Yue Ji did not answer immediately, but adjusted the angle of the bronze mirror. The light and shadow on the mirror changed accordingly, and a faint blue light could be vaguely seen wrapped in the black mist. "The mirror shows that its core is the 'core of elements', but it is wrapped by a layer of shadow energy." She paused, her eyes becoming complicated, "And this shadow energy... is very similar to the aura on the star map fragments I saw in the ancient book library before."
"The fragment of the star map?" Lin Che was shocked, "Is it the star map that is said to record the coordinates of the secret realm?"
Su Li suddenly made an "ah" sound, as if she remembered something. She quickly opened the "Spiritual Plant Illustrated Book" in her arms, turned to one of the pages, and pointed to the illustration: "Look at this! This is the root system diagram of the 'Shadow Vine'. It is said that this plant only grows in places with strong shadow energy. Its roots will absorb the surrounding light energy, leaving traces similar to scorch... exactly the same as the withered state of this piece of moonlight grass!"
The root pattern on the illustration is actually somewhat similar to the pale golden mark on the edge of the black mist in the bronze mirror.
Kai's face darkened: "Shadow energy, cage spell, star map fragments...could this be related to those rumors about the 'Shadow Cult'? I heard that they have been looking for something that can enhance the shadow magic."
"No matter who it is related to, the problem now is that the seal of this energy body can no longer hold up." Silver ripples appeared on Lin Che's fingertips again. He could clearly feel that the fluctuations in the underground space were getting more and more violent, and the pale golden seal was breaking bit by bit. "If it completely breaks through, the energy explosion here may spread to the entire West Campus, and even affect the college's barrier."
